name: bofig-mcp
description: Bofig Cartridge — Evidence graph query tools for investigative workflows
author: Jonathan D.A. Jewell <j.d.a.jewell@open.ac.uk>

tools.name: Query Evidence
tools.description: Query evidence by ID from the graph database

tools.name: Search Evidence
tools.description: Search evidence by keyword (title, description, source)

tools.name: Get Connections
tools.description: Get all connections/relationships for an entity in the graph

tools.name: Find Path
tools.description: Find shortest path between two entities in the evidence graph

tools.name: Get Graph Stats
tools.description: Get overall statistics about the evidence graph
